doc.title: Fred Staton interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 12, 2008

title: Opening and the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band
summary: Introductions; Staton has played six years with the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band, mostly head arrangements.

story.theme_name: Opening the interview: Monk Rowe's welcome and archive boilerplate
story.community_name: Opening the Hamilton College interview: introductions and boilerplate

blocks.x: My name is Monk Rowe and we are interviewing for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive at Hamilton College. I’m very pleased to have Fred Staton, saxophonist, as my guest.
You guys put on a great performance this afternoon with the Harlem Blues and Jazz Band. You mostly do like head arrangements?
And how long have you been with them?
You’ve been playing for a long time, you’re 93, and you’ve seen a lot of change in this country I would imagine.
